Publishing / International perspective

Helping stories travel
beyond the page.

A story may begin at a writing desk. Its conversation can reach much further.

International publishing events bring books into a wider exchange of ideas. They offer a setting for authors, publishers, and rights professionals to discover new work and consider where it might go next.

For Ivy, that wider perspective is part of the work: helping authors present their stories with care, consider their audience, and explore possibilities across cultural boundaries.

The supplied Frankfurt Book Fair photograph features Creating Realistic Works of Art with Barbed Wire by Bernie Jestrabek-Hart.

This image is shared as part of Ivy’s supplied professional gallery. It does not imply event endorsement, an agency affiliation, or a representation agreement with the featured author.
